# Project Contract Templates

Copy only the contracts relevant to the target repository. Review and fill every `TBD` before treating a contract as authoritative.

Suggested starting set for a web product:

- `DESIGN.md`
- `COMPONENT_RULES.md`
- `RESPONSIVE_RULES.md`
- `UI_ACCEPTANCE.md`
- `DESIGN_DECISIONS.md`
- `TYPOGRAPHY_RULES.md`
- `COLOR_RULES.md`
- `MOTION_RULES.md`
- `ACCESSIBILITY_RULES.md`
- `CONTENT_RULES.md`
- `ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md`

Add `3D_RULES.md` only when the product actually contains a Three.js/WebGL/WebGPU scene. These are starting templates, not claims that the project already conforms.
